blocks.text: Cebu’s football community gained a new place to play on September 12, 2026 as AIA Philippines and SM Prime Holdings opened AIA Stadium beside SM Seaside City Cebu, creating a dedicated space for young players, coaches, families and sports enthusiasts. Launched through its inaugural event, the AIA Healthiest Schools Football Clinic, AIA Stadium gives Cebu another space where football, active living and community can grow together. The football clinic was made possible in partnership with the Philippine Football Federation (PFF), Tottenham Hotspur Football Club, the Department of Education Cebu City Division and the local government of Cebu.
